releaseNotes: 6D6X6 2.5.73.0: fixes severe low FPS on Windows 11 caused by reusing one Media Foundation input sample while the H.264 transform could still retain it. Every submitted NV12 frame now owns a separate IMFMediaBuffer and IMFSample, preventing corruption of dependent H.264 frames that Chromium previously discarded. The working DXGI capture, RTP queue, WebRTC routing, audio and Windows 10 paths are unchanged.
